thread_text:
mila: Heads up — saw a ~2-3x tail-latency spike on prod inference around 05:22 UTC after the 1.11.4 merge. Error budgets still fine but p95/p99 jumped for a few routes :frowning:
raj: ugh. which routes? batching or KV-heavy ones?
mila: mainly long-sequence chat endpoints that hit the KV cache and larger batch sizes. p50 stable, p99 went from 320ms -> ~900ms for sequences > 1024.
ivy: can you paste the perf snapshot and the CI run id?
mila: perf snapshot: `s3://rwd-perf/snapshots/2026-03-12/1998764001.json`  CI run: `ci/changes/1.11.4-merge-1998456` (passed unit tests but we see regression in nightly perf)
sylvia: rolling window suggests regression correlates with commit `1998456` (kernel selector heuristics tweak).
raj: let's bisect locally against release branch. If it's the kernel selector patch then fallback behavior might be mis-triggering for cached KV paths.
dan: quick idea: maybe the selector favors a new fused kernel for batch sizes > 8 but that kernel has worse memory access pattern with KV hotpaths. Can we replicate with a synthetic trace?
ivy: running synthetic with seq=1500 batch=12 and KV hit rate ~0.9 now.
ci-bot: perf-run triggered: `perf/run/1998765500` — baseline vs head diff attached.
mila: attaching minimal repro logs:
```
[2026-03-12T05:21:58Z] route=/chat/long seq=1536 batch=12 kv_hit=true latency=912ms kernel=fused-v2
[2026-03-12T05:21:59Z] route=/chat/long seq=1536 batch=4 kv_hit=true latency=330ms kernel=fused-v2
```
raj: hmm fused-v2 seems to spike worse with higher batch sizes when KV hits are frequent. Suggest revert fused-v2 kernel selector change on release branch and run canary.
mila: agreed. plan: create hotfix branch off release-1.11, cherry-pick revert commit, run perf job, then gate rollout if perf improves.
ivy: commands I will run:
```
git checkout -b hotfix/1.11.4-kernel-rollback release-1.11
git revert --no-edit 1998456
git push origin hotfix/1.11.4-kernel-rollback
```
sylvia: also add a temporary feature-flag to force old selector on dedicated pools (so we can A/B test) — that avoids full rollback if we can route a subset.
dan: good call. can you add `selector=legacy` route override for 5% traffic?
ivy: will PR a flag + rollout policy in the console: PR #5142.
ci-bot: creating job `perf/compare/hotfix-1998765432` now.
ops-bot: opened incident `INF-4237` for tracking (severity: low, impact: perf regression on long seqs). Link: https://incidents/redwood/INF-4237
mila: after revert perf-run shows p99 back to 330ms in synthetic; need full prod canary tonight.
raj: after canary, if good, we should backport the revert to release branches and tag a patch release. Who will own cherry-pick verification?
ivy: I will verify logs, sylvia will run rollout and A/B metrics, mila will validate downstream tests.
sylvia: timeline: hotfix branch PR by +20m, perf run +40m, canary deploy +2h, gate/rollback decision +3h.
dan: small checklist: 1) PR diff sanity, 2) perf run artifacts, 3) canary metrics dashboard (latency, error, kv_hit rate), 4) revert cherry-pick to release branch if good.
mila: if canary fails, we'll fully revert commit `1998456` from release and cut 1.11.5 with release notes referencing INF-4237.
ivy: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5141 — includes git revert and a unit test tweak to cover fused-v2 fallback path.
raj: nice. one more: add a perf regression test to CI to catch fused-v2 path for seq>1024 + kv_hit high.
ci-bot: noted — creating ticket `ENG-Perf-847` to add the regression test.
mila: thanks all. keeping thread updated with canary metrics. :thumbsup:
